resolved.title: 变量 Variable
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Variables are used to store values.

In Go, the [b]var[/b] keyword is used to declare variables.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" ]var i int
 [/code]
The code above declares a variable named [b]i[/b] of type [b]int[/b].
[b]int[/b] stands for [b]integer[/b] and represents whole numbers.

We can assign the variable a value and output it:[code format="go" codeId="3295"]var i int = 8
fmt.Println(i) [/code]
[note]We will learn about the other variable types that [b]Go[/b] supports in the next lesson.[/note]

resolved.title: 变量 Variable
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can also declare multiple variables on one line and assign values to them:[code format="go" codeId="3296"]var i, j int = 8, 42[/code]
If you assign a value to the variable, you can omit the type declaration, as Go will automatically take the type of the value assigned:[code format="go" codeId="3297"]var i, j = 8, 42  [/code]
[note]The process of assigning values to variables is called "[b]initialization[/b]".[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You can also declare multiple variables on one line and assign values to them:[code format="go" codeId="3296"]var i, j int = 8, 42[/code]
If you assign a value to the variable, you can omit the type declaration, as Go will automatically take the type of the value assigned:[code format="go" codeId="3297"]var i, j = 8, 42  [/code]
[note]The process of assigning values to variables is called "[b]initialization[/b]".[/note]

content.text: Go中也可以在一行中声明多个变量并为赋值：
content.text_html:
You can also declare multiple variables on one line and assign values to them:

你也可以在一行中声明多个变量并为它们赋值。

content.short_content:
// 一次性定义多个变量且赋值
  var i, j int = 8, 42

content.text: 如果给变量赋值，我们可以省略类型声明，因为Go会自动采用赋值的类型：
content.text_html:
If you assign a value to the variable, you can omit the type declaration, as Go will automatically take the type of the value assigned:

如果你给变量赋值，你可以省略类型声明，因为Go会自动采用赋值的类型。

content.short_content:
// 没有声明变量类型
var i, j = 8, 42

content.text: 变量赋值过程称为**初始化**。
content.text_html:
The process of assigning values to variables is called "initialization".

为变量赋值的过程被称为 "初始化"。

resolved.title: 变量 Variable
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Go supports short variable declaration using [b]:=[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3298"]i := 8
[/code]
It can also be used to declare and initialize multiple variables on one line:[code format="go" codeId="3299"]x, y := 10, 5 [/code]
[note]The [b]:=[/b] operator automatically defines and initialized variables with the given value.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Go supports short variable declaration using [b]:=[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3298"]i := 8
[/code]
It can also be used to declare and initialize multiple variables on one line:[code format="go" codeId="3299"]x, y := 10, 5 [/code]
[note]The [b]:=[/b] operator automatically defines and initialized variables with the given value.[/note]

content.text:
Go支持使用`:=`的短变量声明。

**例如**：
content.text_html:
Go supports short variable declaration using :=.

For example:

Go支持使用**:=**的短变量声明。

例如：

content.text: 也可以在一行中声明和初始化多个变量。
content.text_html:
It can also be used to declare and initialize multiple variables on one line:

它也可以用来在一行中声明和初始化多个变量。

content.content:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
  x, y := 10, 5 
  fmt.Println(x)
  fmt.Println(y)
}

content.text: `:=`操作符自动定义并初始化变量。
content.text_html:
The := operator automatically defines and initialized variables with the given value.

**:=**操作符自动定义并以给定值初始化变量。
